servinfo.title: Water Pump / Generator Drive Belt Tension Inspection and Adjustment

s1.ptxt: Check water pump / generator drive belt for crack, cuts, deformation, wear and cleanliness. If it is necessary to replace water pump / generator drive belt, refer to Water Pump / Generator Drive Belt Removal and Installation:K14C .
Hoist vehicle and remove right side engine under side cover.
When engine is cool, turn crankshaft 720° to stabilize water pump / generator drive belt and check the belt for tension.

item.ptxt: Using sonic tension meter (Gates 508C or equivalent):
Enter the input data following instructions in the tension meter manual.
Flip belt (1) at span to vibrate the belt and measure the belt tension.
If belt tension is not as specified, go to next steps.

spec-sdm.sdm-title: Water pump / generator drive belt tension

item.ptxt: Without using sonic tension meter (Pushing belt span):
Push belt (2) at span with finger force of 100 N (10.2 kgf, 22.5 lbf) to bend the belt and measure the bending value.
If belt tension is not as specified, go to next steps.

spec-sdm.sdm-title: Water pump / generator drive belt tension

sdm1.sdm-value: 4.9 – 5.6 mm (0.19 – 0.22 in.) as deflection / 100 N (10.2 kgf, 22.5 lbf)
sdm1.sdm-ptxt: between water pump pulley and generator pulley

sdm1.sdm-value: 3.7 – 4.7 mm (0.15 – 0.19 in.) as deflection / 100 N (10.2 kgf, 22.5 lbf)
sdm1.sdm-ptxt: between water pump pulley and generator pulley

s1.ptxt: Loosen generator bolt (1), pivot bolt (2) and then adjust belt tension to specification described at Step 2) by loosening / tightening generator adjusting bolt (3).
Tighten generator bolt and pivot bolt to specified torque.
Check belt tension for specification after turning crankshaft two revolutions clockwise.
